versions.content: Shall be able to standardize life cycle states 34 of 57  AUTOSAR CONFIDENTIAL  Document ID 536: AUTOSAR_RS_StandardizationTemplate Requirements on Standardization Template AUTOSAR CP R19-11 Type: valid Description: STDT shall be able to standardize life the states of a particular lifecycle. Rationale: Since AUTOSAR has the goal of being backward compatible it is not possible to just delete a standardized model element and add a new one or - even worse - to change the model element without notification.
